standard_prerequisites.name: The base change of a flat ring map is flat
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives part (1) and is reused for part (2).

core_obligations: Assume B tensor_A B -> B is flat; the map B' tensor_{A'} B' -> B' is the base change of B tensor_A B -> B along A -> A' (compatibility of tensor products with base change), so it is flat by the flat-base-change lemma of the algebra chapter, proving (1) (proof lines 30314-30318). For part (2), weak etaleness of A -> B says the multiplication map is flat, so by part (1) the multiplication map of A' -> B' is flat, i.e. A' -> B' is weakly etale (proof lines 30318-30319).
proof_roadmap: Identify the base-changed multiplication map and prove flatness by base change (proof lines 30314-30318).
Deduce weak etaleness of the base change from part (1) (proof lines 30318-30319).
